topic: Learning to Use an EV Charger

script.title: CHARGING UP
script.story_hook: A first EV charge, step by step, goes well.
script.intro_zh: 第一次幫電動車充電，一步步順利完成。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we learn a public EV charger. Listen for clear how-to phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們學習公共充電站。留意一步一步的說明問句。
script.outro: Eighty percent and smiling. Nice, right?
script.outro_zh: 充到八成，人也笑開了。很厲害吧？
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each charging phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，逐句跟讀這些充電說法。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his late twenties with short curly brown hair and light stubble, wearing a gray zip hoodie, black joggers and running shoes, athletic build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her fifties with straight gray hair in a low ponytail, wearing a teal work vest, black trousers and comfortable flats, kindly face

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is it okay to ask for help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tə æsk fɔɹ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，可以請你幫個忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Is this your first charge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɪz ðɪs jʊɹ fɜɹst tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 當然！這是第一次充電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, I got the car last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm aɪ ɡɑt ðə kɑɹ læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 對，呃，我上週才提車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're lucky: ten open stalls today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊɹ ˈlʌki tɛn ˈoʊpən stɔlz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那你很幸運：今天十個車位都空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! So, which charger should I use?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ soʊ wɪtʃ ˈtʃɑɹdʒɚ ʃʊd aɪ juz/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那我該用哪一台充電機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use number three. First, download our app.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ˈnʌmbɚ θɹi fɜɹst daʊnˌloʊd ˈaʊɚ æp/
dialogue.zh: 用3號。先在手機下載我們的App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downloaded. Now I do what?
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊnˈloʊdɪd naʊ aɪ du wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 下載好了。下一步做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it, then sign up for an account.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ðɛn saɪn ʌp fɔɹ ən əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 打開它，註冊一個帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Account... done! And now?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkaʊnt dʌn ænd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 帳號好了。然後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan the QR code on the charger.
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn ðə ˌkjʊˈɑɹ koʊd ɑn ðə ˈtʃɑɹdʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 掃充電機上的QR碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scanned. It wants a code now?
dialogue.phonetic: /skænd ɪt wɑnts ə koʊd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 掃好了。它現在要什麼驗證碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It texts you four numbers. Enter them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɛksts ju fɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚz ˈɛntɚ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 它會傳一則簡訊，輸入那四個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four seven one two... okay, sent!
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ˈsɛvən wʌn tu oʊˈkeɪ sɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 四七一二……好，發送了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now walk to the car, open the port.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wɔk tə ðə kɑɹ ˈoʊpən ðə pɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 現在走到車邊，打開充電孔的蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here? Okay, the little door is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ oʊˈkeɪ ðə ˈlɪtl̩ dɔɹ ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 這裡嗎？好，小蓋子開好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift the thick cable and push it straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə θɪk ˈkeɪbəl ænd pʊʃ ɪt stɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 拿起粗的那條線，握正穩穩插進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's stuck! I don't want to force it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts stʌk aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə fɔɹs ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 卡住了！我不敢硬推。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop! Press the green tab, then pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp pɹɛs ðə ɡɹin tæb ðɛn pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 別硬來！按綠色鈕，再拉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed... click! It came out free.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɹɛst klɪk ɪt keɪm aʊt fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 按了……喀！解開了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now line it up and push once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ laɪn ɪt ʌp ænd pʊʃ wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 好。現在對準孔，再插一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In! Do you hear that happy beep?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn du ju hɪɹ ðæt ˈhæpi bip/
dialogue.zh: 插進去了！聽到那聲『嗶』了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two short beeps means charging started.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃɔɹt bips minz ˈtʃɑɹdʒɪŋ ˈstɑɹtɪd/
dialogue.zh: 短促兩聲嗶，就是開始充電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! The screen shows power climbing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə skɪn ʃoʊz ˈpaʊɚ ˈklaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有了！螢幕顯示電量在跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow and steady. That's level two here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ænd ˈstɛdi ðæts ˈlɛvəl tu hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 又慢又穩。這邊是慢速樁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow? I thought fast meant this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ aɪ θɔt fæst mɛnt ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 慢？我還以為這台是快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast ones sit on the far last row.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst wʌnz sɪt ɑn ðə fɑɹ læst roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 快充在最裡面那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much more, per hour? Roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɔɹ pɜɹ ˈaʊɚ ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 多收費多少？大概說一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This costs twenty cents per hour less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kɑsts ˈtwɛnti sɛnts pɜɹ ˈaʊɚ lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 慢充每小時少收兩毛錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll stay cheap. How long must I wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl steɪ tʃip haʊ lɔŋ məst aɪ weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我要便宜的。得等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two and a half hours to eighty percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ænd ə hæf ˈaʊɚz tə ˈeɪti pɜɹˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 充到八成，大約兩個半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long! Is there coffee around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ɪz ðɛɹ ˈkɔfi əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好久！這附近有咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A café sits right next to the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæˈseɪ sɪts ɹaɪt nɛkst tə ðə stɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 便利商店隔壁就有咖啡廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. One thing... the cable's heavy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt wʌn θɪŋ ðə ˈkeɪbəlz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。還有…線這麼重是正常的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of them feel like thick rope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ʌv ðɛm fil laɪk θɪk roʊp/
dialogue.zh: 所有的線都像粗繩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Hang it when I'm done?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt hæŋ ɪt wɛn aɪm dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 了解。結束後把線掛回去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hook it back, or others trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hʊk ɪt bæk ɔɹ ˈʌðɚz trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 對，要掛回鉤子，不然有人會絆倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, my wheel nearly hit that line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ups maɪ wil ˈnɪɹli hɪt ðæt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，我的輪胎差點壓到那條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull in a bit more? Now you're golden.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪn ə bɪt mɔɹ naʊ jʊɹ ˈɡoʊldən/
dialogue.zh: 再往前一點？好，現在完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows a timer too. Handy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ə ˈtaɪmɚ tu ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: App還顯示倒數。真方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also emails your receipt later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈiməlz jʊɹ ɹɪˈsit ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 之後還會用email寄收據給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. My first time felt like a quiz!
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs maɪ fɜɹst taɪm fɛlt laɪk ə kwɪz/
dialogue.zh: 真好。我第一次像在考測驗！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people ask twice, then smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl æsk twaɪs ðɛn smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 多數人都會問兩次，然後就笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one more question, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn mɔɹ ˈkwɛstʃən sɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我還有個問題，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask away! That's my whole job.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk əˈweɪ ðæts maɪ hoʊl dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 問吧！這就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If rain comes, is this plug safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɹeɪn kʌmz ɪz ðɪs plʌɡ seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 如果下雨，這個插頭安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally safe. Water can't get inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli seɪf ˈwɔtɚ kænt ɡɛt ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 非常安全，水進不去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew! My town has none of these.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju maɪ taʊn hæz nʌn ʌv ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 呼！我家鄉一台這種站都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more opened last month, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔɹ ˈoʊpənd læst mʌnθ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實上個月剛新開兩站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice. I'll check the app for those.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs aɪl tʃɛk ði æp fɔɹ ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 哦好，我會用App查那兩站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart driver! Your beep means full.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈdɹaɪvɚ jʊɹ bip minz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的車主！嗶一聲就是充好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? Two hours flew by, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɹɛdi tu ˈaʊɚz flu baɪ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就充好了？兩小時飛快地過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coffee shop keeps folks fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔfi ʃɑp kips foʊks fæst/
dialogue.zh: 是咖啡廳讓時間變快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Okay, green tab, pull, and hang.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ɡɹin tæb pʊl ænd hæŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好，按綠鈕、拔出、掛回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it! You're a pro now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt jʊɹ ə pɹoʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣！你現在是老手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty percent. Thanks for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti pɜɹˈsɛnt θæŋks fɔɹ jʊɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 電量八成。謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Charge free on Sundays!
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒɚ tʃɑɹdʒ fɹi ɑn ˈsʌndeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。週日充電免錢！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? I'll be back this Sunday then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi aɪl bi bæk ðɪs ˈsʌndeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 免費？那這週日我一定回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll save you stall number three.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl seɪv ju stɔl ˈnʌmbɚ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你留3號車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Drive safe, and see you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil dɹaɪv seɪv ænd si ju suːn/
dialogue.zh: 說定了！路上小心，再見啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Full battery, happy day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu fʊl ˈbætɹi ˈhæpi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你也是！電拉滿滿，天天開心。

60句電動車充電站聽力練習：第一次開電動車，面對一排充電樁，從下載App到充好離開，每一步都聽得懂。

這一集跟著一位新手司機，學習掃QR碼、輸入驗證簡訊、插槍、卡住怎麼辦、慢充與快充的差價，還有邊充電邊喝咖啡的在地小祕訣。

- 收據、email與週日優惠的閒聊

60 lines of EV charging listening practice: a brand-new electric driver learns a public station step by step with a patient attendant — download the app, scan a QR code, enter a text code, and free a stuck connector without force.

You will hear how to ask what to do next, compare slow and fast charging prices, plan a coffee wait, and hang the cable back. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
